title: After arriving in David Montgomery trade, Juice Scruggs is Lions' starting center

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After arriving in David Montgomery trade, Juice Scruggs is Lions' starting center
sources.description: When the Lions traded running back David Montgomery to the Texans in March, Juice Scruggs was viewed as mostly a throw-in along with the fourth-round pick and seventh-round pick Houston had sent to Detroit.
